portInfo.description: Valletta's Grand Harbour arrival is one of the most dramatic in the Mediterranean: honey-coloured bastions rise straight from the quay. The cruise port, operated by Global Ports Holding as Valletta Cruise Port (VCP), runs along the Valletta Waterfront at Floriana. It handles ships up to 360 m and is used for turnarounds as well as port calls. The main practical issue is height, not distance: the city centre is about 1.5 km away but up the hill, which is why the lift matters.

gettingThere.walkingTime: 5-10 minutes to city center—confirm on your sailing programme before you rely on a fixed walk time.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Upper Barrakka Gardens — terraces over the Grand Harbour, right at the top of the lift. 30 min.
St John's Co-Cathedral — the Knights' baroque church. 60 min.
Republic Street and Merchants Street — the city's spine (editorial).
Fort St Elmo — the star fort at the tip of the peninsula. 75 min.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Ask on board which quay you are at. Pinto Wharf (Quays 1–5) is next to the Upper Barrakka Lift walk. LAB Wharf and Boiler Wharf are across the harbour on the VCP map; Deep Water Quay and Wine Wharf are also separate. For any spill-over berth, use the line's shuttle or a taxi and build in extra return time until a quay-specific walk is verified.
